description: Baseline control run: unmodified main through the exact Stage A harness. Establishes the reference DA / net PnL / p-value that every idea's promotion bar is defined relative to. NOT an idea — the fixed measuring stick.
notes: train-eval --fold 77 --seeds 3 --max-epochs 20 --device cuda. Fold 77 pinned for the whole loop. RESOLVED PROMOTION BAR for all ideas (locked): DA >= 0.5009 (=0.4859+0.015, ~2.7x seed std) AND net PnL > 0 AND p < 0.2. Baseline has NO edge: DA below coin-flip, p=0.859 worse than random, -9.29 net over 1484 fee-bleeding trades. Pre-flight (2026-07-08): pytest 257 passed, mypy/ruff clean, GPU idle, push OK.

description: Add absolute time-of-day + day-of-week cyclical features (sin/cos of UTC hour, sin/cos of day-of-week) to the model input, 5 -> 9 features. Within a 1440-candle (24h) window the encoder sees only RELATIVE returns and has no encoding of WHERE in the clock/week the window sits; BTC has real session (US/Asia) and weekend-liquidity seasonality the model cannot derive from returns alone. This is new information, not a re-expression of existing inputs.
promotion_bar: Stage A: DA >= 0.5009 (baseline 0.4859 + 0.015) AND net PnL > 0 AND p < 0.2. Bar locked before training.
notes: Requires decoupling NUM_INPUT_FEATURES (9) from NUM_OUTPUT_DIMS (5, still OHLCV): model.py line-63 assertion (NUM_OUTPUT_DIMS != NUM_INPUT_FEATURES -> raise) must relax to a prefix-subset check, and the vol-conditioned output scale (line ~150, sigma sliced to first NUM_OUTPUT_DIMS). Time features appended AFTER the 5 OHLCV so output dims [0:5] stay OHLCV. Clock features must BYPASS RevIN + vol-scaling: they are bounded [-1,1] already, aren't predicted, and day-of-week is near-constant within a 24h window (tiny std -> RevIN would amplify it toward instability). compute_features gains timestamps arg (5 call sites: eval/train/deploy scripts + benchmark/engine + training_ui/app all already compute feature_ts = validated.timestamps[1:] right after). This decoupling unlocks the whole feature-eng backlog (multi-scale, higher-timeframe, vol-conditioned all add input-only features).

unspecced_values.revin_scope: first NUM_OUTPUT_DIMS (OHLCV) only; clock features bypass RevIN and vol-scaling
